{{wiktionary|tachi}}
A '''''[[tachi]]''''' (太刀) is a type of Japanese curved sword.
{{TOCright}}
'''Tachi''' may also refer to:

==People==
*{{ill|Tachi (surname)|en|Tachi (surname)|qid=Q26447465|lt=Tachi (surname)}}, a Japanese surname
*{{ill|Tachi (footballer)|en|Tachi (footballer)|qid=Q66382628|lt=Tachi (footballer)}} (Alberto Rodríguez Baró, born 1997), Spanish footballer
*A tribe of Native American Indians in California - see {{ill|Yokuts|en|Yokuts|qid=Q2585783|lt=Yokuts}} and {{ill|Santa Rosa Rancheria|en|Santa Rosa Rancheria|qid=Q7419909|lt=Santa Rosa Rancheria}}

==Other uses==
* Tachi (大刀), Heian Era sword, a version of the {{ill|Chokutō|en|Chokutō|qid=Q63821|lt=Chokutō}} (直刀), a Japanese straight sword
*A Japanese term for {{ill|karate stances|en|karate stances|qid=Q1512259|lt=karate stances}}, varying body positions to attack and defend
*A suffix used in the Japanese language to indicate that a word refers to a group, see the article on [[Japanese grammar#Nouns and other deictics|Japanese grammar]]
*{{ill|TOM'S|en|TOM'S|qid=Q1773593|lt=TOM'S}} (Tachi Oiwa Motor Sports), TOM'S Co., Ltd (株式会社トムス, Kabushiki-gaisha Tomusu), a factory supported racing team and tuner of Toyota and Lexus vehicles
